about.p1: Markdown Studio is a Markdown and LaTeX editor with a native Rust (Tauri) backend for Windows, macOS and Linux.
about.p3: Documents autosave inside the app. Use Ctrl+S to save a real .md file to disk.

g.title: Markdown & LaTeX Syntax Guide
g.intro: A reference for everything **Markdown Studio** can render. Each entry shows the source, followed by the rendered result in a dashed box.
g.mdIntro: Markdown Studio follows **CommonMark** plus **GitHub Flavored Markdown** (GFM): tables, task lists, strikethrough and autolinks.
g.latexIntro: Math is typeset with **KaTeX**, which supports most LaTeX math-mode commands. Use `$...$` for inline math and `$$...$$` on separate lines for display math. If an expression has an error, it is shown in red. Full KaTeX function list: <https://katex.org/docs/supported.html>
g.enterDo: Continue the list (press again on an empty item to end it)
set.spellHint: Checked on your PC — nothing is sent anywhere. “Automatic” accepts German and English words and picks the grammar rules per paragraph.

keys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys (with Ctrl or Alt, or a function key). Esc cancels, Backspace removes the shortcut.
keys.needMod: Please combine with Ctrl or Alt (or use a function key) — otherwise the shortcut gets in the way of typing.

agent.proofreadTask: Proofread the text (or the selection, when one is sent): spelling, grammar, style and clarity. Save the improved version as a new file “{name} (proofread).md” next to it and list the most important changes.
agent.summaryTask: Summarize the text (or the selection) in a few sentences and the key points as a list.
agent.cardsTask: Turn the text into a study sheet in Markdown (headings, key points, 5 test questions with answers) and save it as a new file “{name} – study sheet.md” next to it.
agent.explainTask: Explain the selection in simple words and check whether the facts in it are right.
